summary: Match History + Unmatched Mocks feature fully validated end-to-end. Backend: 9/9 pytest tests passed (auth OTP, match-history seed, idempotency, read-only chat, seeded messages, report). Frontend (mobile 390x844): logged in as testuser@example.com via OTP, /history page shows both 'Anjali Iyer' and 'Priya Bhatia' with REAL names (no 'Unknown'), 'Unmatched' badge, correct dates. Tapping Anjali opens the 'Anjali Iyer has unmatched with you' action sheet; 'View Chat (Read-only)' opens the chat with all 9 seeded mock messages, 'Conversation ended' header, lock banner, and NO input textbox (verified inputs=[]). Report modal opens correctly from the unmatched action sheet for Priya. Idempotency verified - 2nd call to /api/user/match-history/{user_id} still returns exactly 1 Anjali + 1 Priya entry.

minor.issue: Pre-existing 500 in backend logs when user_id query param is empty string (called from chat.tsx on read tracking). Not blocking match-history flow. Should be guarded with 400.

issues: No testID attributes on history rows or action-sheet items - relied on text selectors. Recommend adding testID='history-row-{user_id}', testID='unmatched-view-chat', testID='unmatched-report' for stable automation.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecation warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Triggered from the chat read-only view modal/overlay. Non-blocking.
Multiple 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow' warnings across screens. Non-blocking but should migrate.

action_items: (Optional polish) Add testID attributes to history rows and unmatched action-sheet buttons (View Chat Read-only, Report) for more robust mobile testing.
(Minor) Guard POST /api/chat/read/{conversation_id} with a 400 when user_id is empty to stop log noise (500s).
(Minor) Migrate deprecated shadow* style props to boxShadow and Pressable pointerEvents prop to style.pointerEvents.
critical_code_review_comments: Auto-seed in /api/user/match-history is correctly wrapped in try/except and is best-effort - good defensive pattern.
seed_unmatched_for_user idempotency check uses existence of BOTH conversations - works.

chat_service.get_user_info fallback chain: curated dict -> matchmaking_service.get_mock_user_by_id -> users collection. The mock_unmatched_* IDs resolve via the users collection upsert path correctly.
Read-only enforcement on /api/chat/unmatched checks unmatched_by != user_id - correct.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (history list, real names, action sheet, read-only chat with seeded messages, report modal all working)

seed_data_creation: Logged in via mock OTP as testuser@example.com which triggered auto-seed of Anjali Iyer (mock_unmatched_anjali_iyer) + Priya Bhatia (mock_unmatched_priya_bhatia) unmatched conversations with full chat scripts.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Match history unmatched-mocks fix is verified working end-to-end. Use page.evaluate fetch (not urllib) when calling backend from playwright - the preview env's WAF blocks default urllib user-agent (403). Auth can be pre-injected by setting localStorage '@film_companion_auth' and '@film_companion_onboarding_complete'='true' then navigating to /history.
